item.title: Harry Kane becomes England's most-capped men's footballer
item.body: Harry Kane has become England's most-capped men's footballer. A cap is awarded to a player for each international appearance for their country.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚽ Harry Kane becomes England's most-capped men's footballer

Harry Kane has become England's most-capped men's footballer. A cap is awarded to a player for each international appearance for their country.
